LeadFire · COMING SOON

Keep the connection after the show.

Turn conversations into connections.

LeadFire is being designed to turn event conversations into organized sales follow-up. Exhibitor teams will be able to capture event-authorized contact details through badge scans, qualify interest, and keep the context that makes the next conversation useful—all from a smartphone or tablet.

Talk to us about LeadFire

THE PRODUCT DIRECTION

From the first scan to the next conversation, these planned tools bring lead capture, qualification and team follow-up together. LeadFire is coming soon.

01

Scan a badge. Start a connection.

Planned QR and barcode scanning on smartphones and tablets will connect a badge to the contact profile the event permits exhibitors to access. Available fields may include name, email, job title and company; organizers control which details are shared.

02

Prioritize the right follow-up

Rate leads hot, warm or cold, and use custom qualifiers and tags to record interests, requirements and next steps while the conversation is fresh.

03

Keep the details that matter

Associate written notes, voice memos and photos with a lead, giving your team useful context for a more personal follow-up. Capture only information you have permission to record and share.

04

Keep capturing when connectivity drops

Offline capture with synchronization when connectivity returns is part of the planned workflow, helping teams keep working through an unreliable show-floor connection.

05

Move leads into your sales workflow

CSV export and CRM handoffs are planned, including integrations such as Salesforce and HubSpot. These integrations are not live today; supported connections will be confirmed as the product develops.

06

See the activity behind the leads

An exhibitor team dashboard is planned for total scans, activity timing, lead quality and follow-up reporting. Teams can use those records alongside their sales outcomes to evaluate event ROI; results are not guaranteed.

In development · These are planned capabilities, not currently available features. Final features, integrations and launch timing will be confirmed as LeadFire develops.
